ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the rider's threat/intimidation allegation and the driver's conduct; preserve the full chat log and trip telemetry; contact both parties via RydeHELP; take account action only after human findings.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety dispute type with a recorded chat line capable of being a threat to lock the rider in the vehicle; SAFE-1 mandates escalation instead of an automated ruling.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement that he acted 'for her own safety' is a claim about intent, not consent or a denial of the recorded words; the timestamped chat [F5] controls, and even a safety motive would not resolve the alleged intimidation — it is for the human reviewer.
Distance is 15.4 km vs 15.5 km optimal (-0.1 km) [F1], so there is no off-route segment and no route-deviation refund; the routing clauses are not applicable and are not cited.
